pokedexEntries.bk: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

pokedexEntries.wh: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.

pokedexEntries.sw: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.
